blocks.text: Bu ders miktarlarla ilgili: «kaç ceviz lazım?», «biraz boş vaktimiz var», «pek özel alanımız yok», «iki paket pirinç lazım». Asıl mesele, bir şeyin tane tane sayılıp sayılamadığını anlamak.

examples.en: How many pecans do we need?
We have a little leisure time.
We have little privacy.
We need two bags of rice.

blocks.text: Bazı şeyler tane tane sayılır: a bookend, two ottomans — bir tane için a ya da an, two'dan sonra -s. Türkçede «iki puf» deriz ama İngilizcede sayıdan sonra -s şart. Crockery, gravel, housework gibi sayılmayanlar a ve -s almaz.

examples.en: This is a bookend.
There are two ottomans in the room.
This crockery is new.
This is an errand.
This housework is tiring.

fixes.wrong: There are two ottoman in the room.
fixes.right: There are two ottomans in the room.

fixes.wrong: There are a two ottomans in the room.
fixes.right: There are two ottomans in the room.

drill.why: Karabiber taneleri sayılır: two'dan sonra -s gelir, a konmaz.

sections.title: many mi, much mı — «kaç / ne kadar?»

blocks.text: Türkçedeki ayrım burada işe yarar: «kaç» — many, «ne kadar» — much. How many pecans? How much polenta? Olumsuzda da: We don't have much semolina — «pek irmiğimiz yok». many ve much'tan önce a gelmez.

examples.en: How many pecans do we need?
How much polenta do we need?
We don't have much semolina.
How many commuters use this train?
examples.translation: Bu treni kaç kişi işe gidip gelmek için kullanıyor?

examples.en: How much congestion is there today?

fixes.wrong: How much pecans do we need?
fixes.right: How many pecans do we need?

fixes.wrong: How many polenta do we need?
fixes.right: How much polenta do we need?

fixes.wrong: How a many pecans do we need?
fixes.right: How many pecans do we need?

drill.question: Kursun ödevlerini sayıyorsun; tek tek sayılabilirler. Nasıl sorarsın?
drill.optionA: How much assignments do we have?
drill.optionB: How many assignments do we have?

blocks.text: Az ama var: sayılanlar için a few, sayılmayanlar için a little. We have a few housemates — «birkaç ev arkadaşımız var». We have a little leisure time — «biraz boş vaktimiz var».

examples.en: We have a few housemates.
We have a little leisure time.
We received a few compliments.
We have a little quinoa.

fixes.wrong: We have a few leisure time.
fixes.right: We have a little leisure time.

blocks.text: a'yı kaldırınca anlam değişir: «az, istediğinden daha az». We have little privacy — «pek özel alanımız yok». I have few contact numbers — «az sayıda numaram var». a few / a little — «biraz var», few / little — «yetersiz».

examples.en: We have little privacy.
We received little encouragement.
I have few contact numbers.
We have little buckwheat left.
I received a few voice messages.

blocks.text: Düz cümlede some: We sent some job applications. Olumsuzda ve soruda any: We don't have any contact details; Do you need any childcare? Hem sayılanlara hem sayılmayanlara uyar.

examples.en: We sent some job applications.
We don't have any contact details.
Do you need any childcare?
There aren't any service charges.
Is there any public parking here?

fixes.wrong: We don't have some contact details.
fixes.right: We don't have any contact details.

sections.title: İki paket, iki litre: two bags of…

blocks.text: Sayılmayanı paket ve ölçüyle sayarız: two bags of rice, two litres of milk. Türkçede «iki paket pirinç» yeter; İngilizcede paket -s alır ve arada of şart. Advice da sayılmaz: two pieces of advice.

examples.en: We need two tubes of toothpaste.
We need two bars of soap.
We need two bags of rice.
We need two litres of milk.
I need two pieces of advice.

fixes.wrong: We need two tube of toothpaste.
fixes.right: We need two tubes of toothpaste.
We need two tubes of toothpaste.

fixes.wrong: There are two ottoman in the room.
fixes.right: There are two ottomans in the room.

fixes.wrong: How much pecans do we need?
fixes.right: How many pecans do we need?

fixes.wrong: We have a few leisure time.
fixes.right: We have a little leisure time.

fixes.wrong: We don't have some contact details.
fixes.right: We don't have any contact details.
We need two tubes of toothpaste.

blocks.text: Önce kendine sor: tane tane sayılır mı? Evet — a, -s, many, a few. Hayır — a ve -s yok, much, a little; saymak için paket ve of.
Sayılan — many, a few, few. Sayılmayan — much, a little, little. a ile — «biraz var», a'sız — «yetmiyor». Some düz cümlede, any olumsuzda ve soruda. Paket + s + of.

examples.en: How much knowledge do we need?
I need a little personal space.
We need two slices of cheese.
